name: Pane
purpose: One region of a PaneGroup: the primary or split task pane, the right aside host for Preview, Trash or Filter, or a side column such as the Settings sidebar. Width comes from the group ratio (task panes) or a pixel clamp (aside).

values.when: Left task pane. min-w-0 flex; 100% of the group unsplit (860 of 860), ratio times 100% when split (430 of 860).
Second task pane. border-l edge-2, flex-1, min-w-0. 429x715 at 431,46.

Right aside host, shrink-0, width from previewWidth clamped 280 to 420 (319 in recorded states). Hidden when previewOpen, trashOpen and filterOpen are all false (App.tsx:108). A merged the aside host and the side pane surface into one slot.
No hairline. Primary task pane and task area.
1px border-l edge-2. Split pane and right aside.
Transparent; takes the window colour. Task panes.
bg-surface-1, flex column, h-full, overflow hidden. Side pane surface (inspector, trash, filter), the aside, and the Settings sidebar.

props.name: as
props.description: aside gives complementary role; nav gives navigation role (Settings sidebar); div is generic.

props.name: ratio
props.description: Primary and split: share of the task area when split.

props.name: defaultSize
props.description: Percent of the group: 100 when unsplit, ratio times 100 when split.

props.name: minSize
props.description: Lower clamp. Split pane 25 percent; aside 280 px.

props.name: maxSize
props.description: Upper clamp. Split pane 75 percent; aside 420 px.

props.name: children
props.description: Task list, PreviewPanel, TrashPane or FilterPanel, or the Settings search field and TabList.

role: primary and split: none; aside: complementary; nav: navigation; div: none
keyboard: None. The pane content owns its keys.
platform: Same layout on both. Width is set by pointer drag through Resizer; the reference has no keyboard resize.
open: Merged: A's Sidebar (leading, w-44, shrink-0, border-r, bg surface-1) is this widget with edge trailing, fill surface and as nav; the Sidebar widget is dropped as a duplicate.
